events.summary: Klarna Mobile launched in the Klarna app for UK Max members at no additional cost when switching an existing number; it includes unlimited data, calls and texts plus 20GB monthly global roaming.
events.headline: Klarna adds free unlimited mobile plan for UK Max members

events.summary: Wayfair began offering eligible U.S. customers always-on 0% APR financing for up to six months, while Canadian shoppers gained access to Klarna’s full payment suite at Wayfair for the first time.
events.headline: Klarna and Wayfair deepen ties across the U.S. and Canada

events.summary: Klarna became available on The White Company’s online store, offering Pay in Full, Pay in 3 and Pay in 30 days for homeware purchases.
events.headline: Klarna partners with The White Company

events.summary: Klarna flexible payments became available on flytap.com for customers in the U.S., Spain, France and Italy, including Pay in Full, Pay in 4 and Financing.
events.headline: Klarna expands TAP Air Portugal partnership

events.summary: Ecommpay added Klarna’s Pay in Full, Pay in 3, Pay in 4, Pay in 30 days and Financing options to its platform through a single integration for merchants worldwide.
events.headline: Ecommpay adds Klarna payment options

events.summary: Marks & Spencer customers in Fashion, Home and Beauty gained access to Klarna’s three equal, interest-free payments online and in the app.
events.headline: Klarna launches on M&S.com and the M&S app

events.summary: Klarna became available on Fiserv Commerce Hub for enterprise merchants in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. and select European markets, following its launch at 100,000 U.S. locations through Clover.
events.headline: Klarna expands Fiserv partnership to enterprise merchants

events.summary: Klarna payment options became available for Zoom Workplace subscriptions in Canada, including payment in full or four interest-free installments.
events.headline: Klarna and Zoom expand to Canada

events.summary: Consumer FX lets shoppers buy from participating Klarna merchants worldwide and pay in their own currency with no exchange fee; Klarna said it was live across all its markets and currencies.
events.headline: Klarna launches Consumer FX

events.summary: FreshBooks users in the U.S. and Canada gained Klarna payment methods directly in FreshBooks invoicing and payment flows, without additional merchant setup.
events.headline: Klarna partners with FreshBooks
